# GimbalAngleControl (command)

Gimbal AngleControl. Source: DataGimbalAngleControl.java, confirmed 2026-10-24 against real dji.pilot decompile (dynamic/memscan unpack). An exhaustive call-site search of the decompiled app found this used only for RC master/slave handoff and the third-party Mobile SDK layer - not the app's own interactive FPV gimbal UI, which uses GimbalSpeedControl (0x04/0x0c) instead.

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** dji.pilot decompile (dynamic/memscan unpack, gitignored, not in this repo), DataGimbalAngleControl.java. Was app/awto_dji_app/lib/link/gimbal_commands.dart's `angle()` and scripts/re/duml_commands.py's `GimbalAngleControl`/`gimbal.angle`, hand-duplicated in both languages - migrated here to stop that.
